args: --instructions-append=Grafana 13.2.4 OSS at https://grafana.phlip9.com. Only datasource: {"type":"victoriametrics-metrics-datasource","uid":"victoriametrics"} (PromQL/MetricsQL); use it for every panel target and as datasourceUid for query_prometheus and list_prometheus_*. Dashboards are managed by Grafana Git Sync from github phlip9/dotfiles (this repo), branch master, path nixos/sauna/grafana/ (one JSON manifest per dashboard: {apiVersion, kind, metadata.name=uid, spec}). Grafana pulls master every 60s. To change an EXISTING synced dashboard: edit its manifest file in nixos/sauna/grafana/ (keep the file's apiVersion/schema, Go-style JSON: sorted keys, 2-space indent, <>& escaped as \u003c \u003e \u0026), commit in repo style (e.g. "grafana: node-exporter-full: add disk latency panel") and push; then verify via get_dashboard_summary / query_prometheus. Do NOT call update_dashboard on synced v1 dashboards: it uses the legacy save API, which Grafana rejects for provisioned dashboards (400). update_dashboard is fine for NEW dashboards (v2 schema, k8s API; Git Sync turns the save into a commit on master, and the `message` param is the commit message: always set it) and for unsynced dashboards. Context size: start with get_dashboard_summary, then get_dashboard_property / get_dashboard_panel_queries; avoid get_dashboard_by_uid on big dashboards (Node Exporter Full >500 KiB).
